description: Mandate 18 usage dashboard. Uses CUR usage units rather than cost because the account is credit-backed.

panels.title: 1. Data Transfer — NAT Gateway, VPC Endpoint and Cross-AZ

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS nat_gateway_hours
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Hours%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)

panels.title: NAT data processed
panels.description: CUR usage amount for NatGateway-Bytes; shown in GB by AWS billing data.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS nat_processed_gb
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Bytes%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)

panels.title: Cross-AZ data transfer
panels.description: Regional data transfer charged by AWS; shown in GB.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS cross_az_gb
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)

panels.title: VPC Endpoint usage
panels.description: Gateway endpoints such as S3 have no hourly charge. Interface endpoint usage, if introduced, is visible here.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
       pricing_unit AS unit,
       SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS usage_amount
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: NAT and Cross-AZ data transfer trend

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('day', line_item_usage_start_date) AS time,
       SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS nat_processed_gb
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Bytes%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', line_item_usage_start_date) AS time,
       SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS cross_az_gb
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(line_item_resource_id, ''), 'not resource-tagged') AS resource_id,
       line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
       pricing_unit AS unit,
       SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS usage_amount
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: EBS volume usage by type
panels.description: GB-month usage from CUR. gp2 should be zero after migration; gp3 is the expected persistent-volume type.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
       pricing_unit AS unit,
       SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS gb_month
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VolumeUsage%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: EBS snapshot usage
panels.description: Snapshot usage must have a finite AWS Backup lifecycle; this panel shows the retained GB-month consumption.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
       pricing_unit AS unit,
       SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS gb_month
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND (line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapshotUsage%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapUsage%')
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
